top_categories.workout_context: 2237 miles. Your legs will beg to quit after 120. This trains the power output you need from mile 130 onward.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Race Around Poland's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before June.
At Race Around Poland, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.

Road-specific control matters at Race Around Poland. Practice on mixed terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 2237 miles.
108,596ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
Race Around Poland's mixed terrain rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
2237 miles rewards fat oxidation. This volume work shifts your fuel mix so you're still burning fat at hour 5, not bonking at hour 3.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 108,596ft of climbing on mixed terrain does to your power file on race day.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 2237 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
108,596ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Race Around Poland. Train it until it feels boring.
Low-cadence force work supports 108,596ft of climbing when the grade lowers cadence. Practice controlled torque while preserving good form.

race_overlay.nutrition: For a multi-day 2237-mile race, no single calorie total or one-food strategy is credible. Rehearse continuous intake while riding plus substantial meals at planned stops; document carbohydrate, fluid, and sodium intake, resupply cadence, and gut response. Use checkpoints and publicly available services only as the category rules allow, carry backup calories, and complete a full night-riding systems rehearsal.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at Race Around Poland rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on mixed terrain to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, Race Simulation, and Over Under to prepare you for 2237 miles of mixed terrain in Warsaw, Poland.
